brief:
Settlers attacked the Duwara area in Sair, north of Hebra, injuring two Palestinians, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assault took place in the northern section of the Hebron governorate in the occupied West Bank.

The identities of the injured Palestinians and the specific circumstances that preceded the attack were not immediately disclosed. Settler violence in the area has been a recurring source of tension, with incidents frequently reported across communities in the southern West Bank.
title: Settlers attack Palestinians in Hebron Hills, injure two
